title: ATS Integration: How to Enrich Your Own Candidate Database via API
summary: How to fill, govern, and refresh candidate records in your own ATS from an enrichment API, including the schema flags and retention lifecycle that keep you compliant.
body_markdown: Manmohit covers real-time data infrastructure and intelligence layers for sales, recruiting, and investment platforms. At Crustdata, he leads engineering, transforming live data changes like job moves, hiring spikes, funding events and more into structured, reliable APIs that product teams can use to build automated workflows.
